# Ratecard

> Published AI API list prices (USD per 1M tokens), one row per model and provider, each with a source URL and check date. 99 rows, 70 verified, 14 providers. Last checked 2026-10-31.

## Methodology
Prices come only from each provider's own pricing page, docs, or public pricing API. Unverified means we could not read a number on the check date — the cell stays blank. We never invent rates. Details: https://ratecardai.pages.dev/methodology

## Data (CC BY 4.0 — please attribute "Ratecard" + link https://ratecardai.pages.dev/)

- [Change log (JSON)](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/api/changes.json)
- [Change log (CSV)](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/api/changes.csv)
- [OpenAPI](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/openapi.json)
- [Full dump](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/llms-full.txt)

## Dataset summary
- Units: USD per 1M tokens (unless unit/other says otherwise)
- Fields: input, output, cached, batch_input, batch_output, context, long_context, status, source, checked
- Cheapest verified text (in+out): OpenRouter Qwen3.7 Flash (Qwen) ($0.030 / $0.13)

## Scheduled price increases
- [Scheduled AI API price increases](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/scheduled-increases): 27 announced price changes with effective dates, old → new prices, % change and sources (last checked 2026-10-31)
- [Scheduled increases (JSON)](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/api/scheduled.json)
- Billing rule change 2026-11-01: DeepSeek — Agent server-side Search and Fetch tool calls, free until then, start per-request billing. Direct Search/Fetch API calls were never in the free period. $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests (Search); $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests (Fetch). Source: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing
- Billing rule change 2026-11-13: Google — When a completion exceeds 32K tokens, retrievable token usage is charged even if the request ultimately fails due to client or server timeouts (today only 200 responses are charged). Standard token rates for retrievable tokens. Source: https://cloud.google.com/model-garden/pricing

## Guides
- [DeepSeek Search & Fetch API pricing](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/guides/deepseek-search-fetch-pricing): $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests each (standalone APIs billed per request; Harness/Claude Code/Codex agent tool calls billed from 2026-10-31 16:00 UTC).

## Cheapest by context (verified text, ranked by input then output $/1M)
- [≥128K context](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/cheapest/128k-context): 54 models; cheapest OpenRouter Qwen3.7 Flash (Qwen) $0.030/$0.13 (as of 2026-10-31)
- [≥1M context](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/cheapest/1m-context): 40 models; cheapest OpenRouter Qwen3.7 Flash (Qwen) $0.030/$0.13 (as of 2026-10-31)
- [Index](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/cheapest/)
- Rule: when the page threshold exceeds a model long_context.threshold, long-tier rates are shown. OpenRouter = gateway list price.
